project.description: RFC 0066 Episode 3, layer 2 - the DOM-level components, one module each, every one on layer 1 alone: core, core-js, the component base and the design core. A component here owns its elements through a branch it is handed, wears words and paints nothing, and has a crate. Built fresh beside what the studio has, not cut from it; a demo switches to a component here when it is good enough, and the studio's own retires only then. The first is the elements: a button and a card.
